annotation.summary: Removed Read snapshots ca0, out0, requested and helper snapshot d0. The unchanged nullable Read ownership branches are packaged by CircularAreaReadInput so QCP has one syntactic entry branch and data_length@pre remains available after the local parameter is clamped.
spec_changes: CircularAreaRead keeps only state, LitMap, output_capacity, and output_before as semantic With binders.
CircularAreaReadInput packages the original three nullable ownership branches without changing any pure bound or spatial resource.
Read Ensure uses circular_area@pre, output_buffer@pre, and data_length@pre; body assertions use data_length@pre for the original requested length.
CircularAreaDivideRdData removes d0 and uses data_length directly in Require/Ensure and data_length@pre inside its single-branch body.
CircularAreaReadResult and unified store_circular_area FIFO semantics are unchanged.
